title: An answer in a thread this hub opened is not declined: the liaison closes it (done) or passes it on; a request in the other hub's thread is handled as before
note: The frame as liaison.inbound prints it: after — with IN_OURS and the line of actions without decline (IN_DO_OURS), both read from the version's core/liaison.py; before — the frame of main. Checks by the command only. The core refuses a decline of such an item (decline_ours); the last turn checks that its refusal leads to done or an answer in the thread.
